question: By October 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated _______ Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samruddhi Kendras.
solution:
The correct answer is __**600.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samruddhi Kendras:-**

 
• PM-KISAN is a scheme launched by the Government of India to provide farmers with agriculture-related information and services.
 
• These centers aim to educate farmers about modern agricultural techniques and help them become more productive.
 
• The following facilities are available at PM-KISAN centers:
 
 
• Information and training on agricultural technology and innovations
 
• Sale of agricultural equipment and seeds
 
• Agricultural loans and other financial services
 
• Agricultural insurance and other protection schemes
 
• Opportunities for marketing and value addition of agricultural products
 
 
 
• **600 Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samruddhi Kendras **have been inaugurated by **PM Narendra Modi **by** October 2022.**
